about_me.title: Hi, I'm <u>Baptiste CAUVIN</u>, a {role} based in Paris, FRANCE.
description: With that site, you can have a glimpse of what I can do. Because in term of projects, I've worked 3 years at BNP Paribas and all of their projects are confidential and on their intranet, so I can't show what I did during those 3 years. Moreover, with that site, I've gained some experience, because this is the first time I make a site from scratch, from the choice of techno, the setup of the site, the different package used, to how to deploy a site, how to get an url, passing by the design of the site (with some inspiration from other) and resolving problems by myself (with the help of my IA buddy).

For now, my choice in term of technologies is what I know the most, so Vue.js with Vuetify and Vite. I've used that because my biggest experience,the 3 years at BNP Paribas, was with those technologies. With these technologies, I have a solid base to be sure that my site is working, that I can develop it quick and also experiment with new things that I wanted to try along the way.
I enjoy discovering new thing, so I've planned to try other technologies after, try new challenges. I have a few in mind :
project_list: Trying to remove bit by bit Vuetify from that site, to experiment other way to make a site, make it responsive and everything. Because I have the feeling that with vuetify is to easy, and in the end, you can tell easily when a site use Vuetify (are any Material Design template).

Make this site (are another one because, maybe, it will be repetitive) with React.js. To remind me of the little difference between Vue.js and React.js and refreshing my memory about it because it been quite some times since I last used React.js.
Other that I have in mind and hoping to have the time to see them through.

pimpMyApp.title: 2020 PimpMyApp (Deloitte)
description: Two-week project. The goal was to work with a company that gave us a problem. In teams of 5-6 people, within the given time, we had to think about the problem, propose solutions, and finally have a prototype of the solution to show.

We did it with the help of the Agile method. On our side, we were in collaboration with GRTgaz, to prototype a web app. It aimed to improve teleworking conditions during the lockdown for their employees. Use of the Design Sprint method and various tools, such as Mural and Figma.

feetBack.title: 2019-2020 FeetBack
description: Team project of 6 focused on health. Throughout the school year, alongside classes.

Device allowing remote monitoring of the wear and reliability of orthopedic insoles. At the end of the year, we had a functional prototype, a mobile application connected to the insole and finally a website for doctors to consult the insole data.
On my side, I was mainly the tester since I have orthopedic insoles in everyday life and worked on the development of the website in React.

armOfHearing.title: 2017-2018 Arm Of Hearing
description: Team project also focused on health. Throughout the school year, alongside classes.
Our goal was to create a device that translates sign language into spoken language. In the end, we had a device that could detect the entire alphabet.
For this project, I mainly helped with the design of the glove that detected the movements.

bnp.description: On a 3-year assignment as a {role} in the Automation team at BNP Paribas. Focused on process automation and web development for support. My role involved using technologies such as Node.js, Vue.js (Vuetify framework), TypeScript, and MongoDB. We followed an agile methodology with two-week sprints, using Jira for project management. Sprint reviews were conducted to evaluate progress.

eatic.description: Internship at Eatic as a {role}. Vue.js and Node.js were the main languages used. I mainly worked on developing version 2.0 of the application. I developed the application specifications and participated in numerous tests.
